FC Barcelona Defeats Galatasaray in Champions League Match

FC Barcelona secured a victory against Galatasaray in a Champions League match held in Istanbul. The team, managed by Flick, made several lineup changes for the game. A single goal was sufficient for Barcelona to win against Galatasaray.
